posts.text:
Retail is 43.7% of NBFC loans, but took 57.8% of new NBFC credit in Aug 2026. Retail grew 22.0% against 15.8% for all NBFC lending. Inside retail: gold loans +69.1%, consumer durables +56.4%.

(NBFCs: RBI's reporting sample.)
#NBFC #RetailCredit

posts.text:
Bank credit to industry grew 18.2% in Aug 2026.

In the Apr–Jun quarter, net of prices (national-accounts deflator, +3.9%), industry credit grew 14.8%, while industry's real output grew 7.9% over the four quarters to Q1.

#BankCredit #Manufacturing

posts.text:
Debit card spend at shops fell 7.4% over the year to Aug 2026: SBI −9.3%, HDFC −6.1%, ICICI −7.3%.

UPI QR codes grew 16.5% over the same year. Is UPI taking the debit card's place at the counter?

#DebitCards #UPI #DigitalPayments

posts.text:
Housing is 47.4% of bank personal loans but took 32.8% of the new ones in Aug 2026. It grew 11.1%; net of consumer prices (CPI, +4.8% over the year), 6.0%.

NBFC housing loans grew 12.1%.

#HousingFinance #BankCredit #NBFC

POS terminals fell 14.7% over the year to Aug 2026. Most of that is one bank: ICICI Bank −91.9%.

Elsewhere the network grew: HDFC +17.0%, SBI +8.6%, Axis +6.3%.
